title: 第19章 绕着巷子转圈圈第20章 女性失踪案
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第19章绕着巷子转圈圈
这会吴妈妈是再也不敢轻视林熙，甚至和婆婆一样，把她视为大师了。
可如果按照林熙的说法，那儿子和那鬼的约定不是已经完成了吗，儿子却一直没有恢复正常，这到底是怎么回事？
林熙给了吴妈妈一个安抚的眼神，道：“别担心，吴斌和那鬼之间的约定已完成，之所以他还在吴斌赖着身上不走，纯粹是他自己贪心不足。”
大概是觉得这样的生活太好太美妙了，忘了自己一开始说的话，所以才迟迟不离开。
当然，也有部分原因是吴斌实在是太年轻，压根没有和对方规定好确切的时间。
一天是“体验生活”
，可一年，十年，也都可以称之为“体验生活”
如果林熙没有来的话，不排除一种可能，那就是那鬼一直霸占着吴斌的身体，直到吴斌的身体因为受阴魂影响太大，而生病死去。
“什么？我服了，这个鬼也太无语了吧，亏我还觉得他死了这么多年啥也没体验过挺可怜的呢，结果他竟然趁机想霸占我的身体！”
吴斌还没意识到问题的严重性，只觉得那鬼背信弃义，恩将仇报！
吴妈妈和周奶奶则是想的更多，她们想着如果那鬼一直不离开的话，岂不是儿子孙子就一直都是这个样子，她们再也见不到他了？！
不过还好，还好有林熙！
两人看向林熙的目光更多了几分感激，又问了一下吴斌现在的情况还有没有什么需要注意的，听林熙说没了，两人才终于放心。
事情解决了，林熙也打算回去了。
不过在回去之前，吴妈妈可没忘记一件事情——那就是报酬，也就是林熙这次来帮忙的辛苦费。
吴妈妈也是第一次经历这样的事情，周奶奶虽然看人请过先生，可她还真不知道该给多少钱合适。
于是两人只能眼巴巴的看着林熙，期待她自己出价格。
可林熙却只是笑了笑，说了句：“随心就好。”
吴妈妈和周奶奶对视一眼，最终只能感慨一句：大师不愧是大师，就是这么淡泊名利。

而她们不知道的是，林熙之所以不主动开价，完全是因为这样会有损自己的形象和身价。
毕竟纵横古今，哪一位能人异士会在自己家里贴张收费表，明码标价的，那太不符合大师仙风道骨的形象了。
当然，算命卜卦这种小事倒是不用这么在意。
但这样做也有弊端，就是有人会想趁机占便宜，在给酬劳的事情上过于吝啬。
当然，在遇到这种人的时候，林熙就会有意识地避开和他们打交道，自然也不存在被这种人占便宜的情况。
所以一般情况下，和她打过交道的人都不会在报酬这种事情上弄虚作假，毕竟谁也不知道以后还会不会遇到点别的事情。
因为一点小钱就失去了下一次和大师打交道的机会，实在是得不偿失。
林熙丢下那句听起来很高深的话之后便离开了吴家，而在两分钟后，手机便收到了来自周奶奶的转账。
两万元整。
林熙看了一眼，心情格外不错。
照例捐出一半之后，眼看时间快到中午了，她便朝吴家小区门口的一家饭店走去。
那家饭店上面写着“串串香”
几个大字，又是一种她没有尝试过的美食，林熙果断走了进去。
串串香生意不错，虽然还没正式到饭点，但店里也坐了几桌人了。
服务员见林熙坐下之后便安静的看着自己，猜测她是第一次来，而且还很有可能是第一次吃串串。
于是她快步走上前，对她道：“同学，咱们这串串是自己想吃什么拿什么，吃法跟火锅一样，把菜放里面烫熟就行，吃完了之后把串串放在这个小桶里，最后结账是数串串的根数。”
content_en:
Chapter 19 Going around the alley
Now Mother Wu no longer dared to look down on Lin Xi, and even regarded her as a master like her mother-in-law.
But if according to Lin Xi, the agreement between the son and the ghost has been completed, but the son has never returned to normal. What is going on?
Lin Xi gave Wu's mother a comforting look and said, "Don't worry, the agreement between Wu Bin and the ghost has been completed. The reason why he is still hanging on to Wu Bin is purely because of his own greed."
Probably because I felt that this kind of life was too good and wonderful, and I forgot what I said at the beginning, so I didn't leave for a long time.
Of course, part of the reason is that Wu Bin is too young and has not set an exact time with the other party at all.
One day is to "experience life"
, but one year or ten years can also be called "experience life"
If Lin Xi had not come, one possibility cannot be ruled out, that is, the ghost had been occupying Wu Bin's body until Wu Bin's body was too affected by the ghost and fell ill and died.
"What? I'm convinced. This ghost is too speechless. I still think it's pitiful that he hasn't experienced anything since he's been dead for so many years. But he actually took the opportunity to take over my body!"
Wu Bin didn't realize the seriousness of the problem yet, he just felt that the ghost was treacherous and wanted to repay kindness with revenge!
Mother Wu and Grandma Zhou were thinking more. They thought that if the ghost never left, wouldn't their son and grandson be like this all the time, and they would never see him again? !
But fortunately, fortunately, Lin Xi is there!
The two of them looked at Lin Xi with more gratitude, and asked if there was anything else that needed attention to Wu Bin's current situation. When Lin Xi said that it was okay, the two of them finally felt relieved.
After the matter was resolved, Lin Xi also planned to go back.
But before going back, Mother Wu did not forget one thing - that was the reward, which was Lin Xi's hard work fee for coming to help this time.
It was also the first time for Wu's mother to experience such a thing. Although Grandma Zhou had asked someone to hire a husband, she really didn't know how much she should pay.
So the two of them could only look at Lin Xi eagerly, expecting her to pay the price herself.
But Lin Xi just smiled and said, "Just do whatever you want."
Mother Wu and Grandma Zhou looked at each other, and in the end they could only sigh: Master is indeed a master, but he is so indifferent to fame and fortune.
What they didn't know was that the reason why Lin Xi didn't take the initiative to offer a price was entirely because it would damage her image and worth.
After all, throughout ancient and modern times, any capable person would post a fee list in his home with a clearly marked price. That would be very inconsistent with the image of a great master.
Of course, you don’t need to worry so much about trivial things like fortune telling.
But there are also drawbacks to this, that is, some people may want to take advantage of the situation and be too stingy in terms of remuneration.
Of course, when meeting such people, Lin Xi would consciously avoid dealing with them, and naturally there would be no chance of being taken advantage of by such people.
So under normal circumstances, people who have dealt with her will not cheat on matters such as remuneration. After all, no one knows whether they will encounter other things in the future.
Losing the next opportunity to deal with a master just because of a small amount of money is really not worth the loss.
Lin Xi left the Wu family after leaving those profound-sounding words, and two minutes later, her mobile phone received a transfer from Grandma Zhou.
Twenty thousand yuan.
Lin Xi took a look and was in a particularly good mood.
After donating half as usual, seeing that it was almost noon, she walked towards a restaurant at the entrance of Wu's community.
That restaurant has "Chuan Chuan Xiang" written on it
A few big characters, another delicacy she had never tried before, Lin Xi walked in decisively.
Chuan Chuan Xiang is doing a good business, and although it’s not officially dinner time yet, there are already a few tables filled with people in the store.
When the waiter saw Lin Xi sitting down, he looked at her quietly.Looking at himself, he guessed that this was her first time here, and it was probably her first time eating skewers.
So she walked up quickly and said to her: "Classmate, we can get whatever the skewers we want to eat. The way to eat them is just like hot pot. Just put the vegetables in and boil them. After you finish eating, put the skewers in this small bucket. At the end of the check, you will count the number of skewers."
